name: GET /api/leadflow/sequences/nurture - the reason-segmented tracks and who is on them
description:
Nurture SEGMENTED BY REASON, not by list (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC1). Seven segments, each with its own cadence and its own approach: timing anchors on the buyer date, budget sends a business case and NEVER repeated discounting, current-contract anchors on the renewal, product-gap sends verified status only with no vague coming-soon, no-response changes the REASON rather than the subject line. One stream serving six reasons sends the same thing to somebody waiting on a budget cycle and somebody mid-contract with a competitor.

EVERY NURTURE RECORD MUST RETAIN ONE OWNER AND ONE DATED NEXT ACTION (0a3474c3-56f8-4af6-8931-eb27cfddc13c#AC2), and this endpoint REPORTS THE VIOLATIONS rather than quietly listing the members. A nurture record with no next action never comes back - it is indistinguishable from a record nobody is working, which is what nurture is supposed to prevent. The invariant is stated in the response so a reader knows what the violations array means.

QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: The tracks and their members come back, with any invariant violations named
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
